title: The Dry Bones
buttonText: Show the phases of the vision
intro: Ezekiel receives a dramatic vision of a valley full of dry bones coming back to life. The vision is a prophecy about Israel's restoration from exile, but it also points to spiritual awakening and the final resurrection.

items.title: The Valley of Dry Bones
items.text: The Lord's Spirit brought Ezekiel out into a valley full of bones - very many and completely dried up. God asked: 'Can these bones live?'

items.title: Prophesy to the Bones
items.text: Ezekiel was told to prophesy: 'Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord! I will cause breath to enter you, and you shall live.'

items.title: The Bones Come Together
items.text: There was a rattling sound, and the bones came together. Tendons and flesh appeared on them, and skin covered them - but there was no breath in them.

items.title: The Breath Brings Life
items.text: Ezekiel prophesied to the breath: 'Come from the four winds and breathe on these slain!' The breath entered them, they came to life and stood up - an exceedingly great army.

items.title: The Interpretation: Israel Will Rise Again
items.text: The bones represent the whole house of Israel. They said: 'Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost.' But God will open their graves and bring them back to the land of Israel.

items.title: The Two Sticks
items.text: Two sticks - one for Judah and one for Joseph/Ephraim - will become one in Ezekiel's hand. In this way, God will gather the divided kingdoms of Israel into one people under one king.

items.title: One King, One Covenant
items.text: David (the Messiah) will be their king. They will keep God's commands, and he will make an everlasting covenant of peace with them. His sanctuary will be among them forever.

footer.title: Fulfillment
footer.content: The vision was partially fulfilled at the return from exile and with the establishment of the state of Israel in 1948. Spiritually, it points to new birth (John 3) and the work of the Holy Spirit. Complete fulfillment awaits Christ's return and the resurrection of the dead.
